findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "find_tenders" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Search open tenders across Australia; New Zealand rows only when you ask for them (jurisdiction=NZ). FREE, within the weekly cap. USE THIS WHEN someone asks wha…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-tenders" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_tenders, tender_sources, buyer_awards · Private data: find_tenders, match_tenders, buyer_awards, find_signals · Public sink: find_tenders, buyer_awards · Destructive: tender_sources.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_tenders, tender_sources, buyer_awards · Private data: find_tenders, match_tenders, buyer_awards, find_signals · Public sink: find_tenders, buyer_awards · Destructive: tender_sources

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
